This skill is the **written procedure** for onboarding a user; the automation of
the sequence is roadmap and will be deepened with a dedicated interview. Each
step uses a command or a stage contract that exists today.

Argument received: `$ARGUMENTS`

> This skill writes into a data root: it runs only when the user types it.

## Steps

1. **Data root.** If the user has none: `cvac init <dir> --user <slug>`; then
   work inside it. If one exists: `cvac validate --all`.
2. **Questionnaire.** `cvac stage show 05_interview --user <slug> --name
   01-onboarding` (both inputs may be absent for a new user); follow the
   stage's `INSTRUCTIONS.md` with the attached skeleton and write
   `users/<slug>/interviews/01-onboarding.md` in the user's language. Tell the
   user where it is and that they fill it at their own pace, then set
   `status: filled`. **Stop here** until they do; do not interview on screen.
3. **Extraction.** When the questionnaire is `filled`: `cvac stage show
   03_extract --user <slug> --document interviews/01-onboarding.md --name
   01-onboarding`; follow the stage's `INSTRUCTIONS.md` and write the evidence
   note; validate it; then apply its facts to `profile.yaml` as `draft` with
   the note as evidence (and `new_parents` as experiences/projects), write
   `search.yaml` from section G, set the note's `status: applied`, and
   `cvac validate --all`.
4. **Verification.** List every `draft` fact with its quote and ask the user to
   confirm, correct or reject each one. Only on their word set `verified` and
   `verified_on` (or `rejected`). Never verify on their behalf.
5. **First master.** `/cv-master <name>`.
6. Report: how many facts verified, what stays draft, what documents the user
   could drop in `inbox/` for a second extraction round.
